sourceReceipts.title: Xwi7xwa Library: Indigenous Knowledge Organization
sourceReceipts.locator: Classification System; For Libraries; Subject Headings
sourceReceipts.findings: Xwi7xwa describes its local British Columbia variant of Brian Deer classification and a distinct FNHL subject vocabulary. It distinguishes shelf placement from multiple topic headings.
sourceReceipts.limits: Its implementation serves a particular library and audiences. It is not a universal Indigenous taxonomy or an atlas reuse authorization. The page says tours/meetings about the scheme are not currently accepted.
sourceReceipts.reuse: Citation and original analysis only; no source PDF, image, label icon, template, song, recording or other asset redistributed.
